name: anon-comms-inbox
description: Anonymous comms inbox: only the first message pings until the receiver acts, the comms hub stays the last inbox message, notification lines carry no buttons, and Hacan (Guild Ships) keeps comms with colors it has encountered.

steps.note: you = red, seat1 = blue, seat2 = green (Hacan), seat3 = yellow. Red and Green both neighbour Blue only.

steps.label: GM enables Anonymous comms
Turn start runs the partner check
Red sends Blue a first message
First message pings Blue
Hub follows with an Open button for Red
Notification line has no Reply button
Pretend Blue's ping is still unacknowledged
Red sends Blue a second message
Second message stays silent
Exactly one new hub

steps.note: Check: Blue's inbox shows two 📨 lines without buttons, only the first with a mention, and a single 📇 hub at the bottom (Red green).

steps.label: Blue opens Red from the hub
Opening re-arms Blue's ping
Red's own inbox has a hub too
Guild Ships alone does not reach a stranger
Pretend Green met Red earlier
Next turn start reruns the partner check
Hacan reaches encountered Red
Red's partners do not reveal Guild Ships
Hacan writes to Red
Red may now answer Hacan
Red answers Hacan

steps.note: Check: before Hacan wrote, Red's hub showed Green red (or not at all); after it, Green is a green button. Yellow is absent.
